behavior: During an exit animation, no focusable content is under `aria-hidden`, and the focus is not in the closing popup. `Combobox.Popup`, `Dialog.Popup` and `Drawer.Popup` stop their focus manager when the popup closes, so their focus guards, which have `aria-hidden`, go at the close, and the focus returns at the close. This is also true while `preventUnmountOnClose()` keeps a dialog mounted. The focus also returns to the trigger of the outer popup when a popup inside it, such as a nested dialog or a menu, closes in the same update. The focus also returns there when that popup closes later, during the exit of the outer popup. Base UI stops the focus manager when the popup unmounts.
